package store

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// bypassHoistedLiteral is what a guard checking only the literal-ness of the call-site
// argument would miss: the SQL is still spelled out as literal pieces, but those pieces are
// concatenated into one string before reaching Query, so the argument at the call site is a
// binary expression, not a literal.
func bypassHoistedLiteral(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, scope string) {
	head := "select uid from documents where scope = '"
	pool.Query(ctx, head+scope+"'")
}
